result.document_summary: A middle chunk of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 2, Article 2, Division 30 (city contractor standards, bonds, bidding and bid-protest procedures), fetched from a page URL about the algorithmic rent-pricing ban but containing only unrelated public procurement text.
result.notes: This part contains only City procurement and contracting provisions (Sections 22.3004 to 22.3017: contractor standards, insurance and bonds, specifications, bid opening, protests). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The URL suggests San Diego's algorithmic rent-setting prohibition (Div. 11, Sec. 98.1103), but that text is not included in this part, so no rule is extracted.
